Alex / Elena,

Thanks again for the conversation today. I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Nimbus_MAP_v3.pdf) and a simple commit schedule (commit_schedule_q3-q4.xlsx) that maps the evaluation milestones to our commercial milestones. High-level ask: if Nimbus can commit to the pilot acceptance milestone and a defined token ramp into Q4, we can offer a discretionary pilot incentive tied to the MAP (details below).

Proposal highlights:
- Pilot evaluation: 8-week technical evaluation (POC acceptance = Milestone 2)
- Commercial ramp: 25% utilization increase month-over-month after go-live through Q4
- Incentive: up to an 18% off invoice pilot rebate, payable on successful POC + signed 12-month commitment (T&Cs in the MAP)

Can you confirm the acceptance criteria for Milestone 2 and whether procurement needs any additional paperwork? If the incentive looks reasonable, I’ll route an internal discount request for exec sign-off (VP/CFO/CEO) — our standard for >15% concessions.

Next steps:
- You confirm the Milestone 2 acceptance criteria by EOD Mon 6/14
- I’ll spin up the discount request and loop in finance/ops for approval
- If approved, we’ll share a DocuSign IPA and target a July 1 kickoff for the pilot

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
